review.images: Reviewed the official corporate project gallery and the Aldar brochure reproduced on Reelly. Preserved three embedded originals from physical pages 20, 21 and 27. Aldar’s page also displays a Gardenia Bay illustration in an amenity section. Excluded that image and used only the confirmed Yas Park Place scenes.
review.location: Visually verified the project label beside Yas Park and times and distances on brochure physical page 5. Those numbers are Yas Island estimates. Excluded the unspecified Dubai endpoint from the cards. Name-based directions avoid passing a broker area pin off as the entrance.
review.floorPlans: The ten-page source matched the cached original. Visually checked the five residence plans on physical pages 6–10 and left building floor plates in the PDF. The plans do not print total areas. Aldar’s separate brochure physical page 29 prints the five category averages used here. Larger examples from broker pages have a different area basis and were not assigned to these sheets.

unavailable: Exact measured area and orientation for each illustrated unit and an independently verified entrance pin.
